date_scope_check.qualification_retained:
REC50-R21-004-P1: The road barrier removed on November 23, 2017, checkpoint restrictions and subsequent road threats are not assumed to form one uninterrupted closure affecting every cohort. Restrictions are documented on November 24 and by the mayor on December 5; restricted passage and a next-day reopening plan were reported on December 6. Returning nationals were permitted, and some women passed without their goods.

The original Tunisien report on December 7 is prospective. A newly recovered Zoom Tunisia report, also dated December 7, uses completed-action language and cites TAP and a crossing official: activity resumed that Thursday. This supplies a qualified restoration bound of December 7. The exact first restoration for each cohort and consistent onset remain unknown. Conflicting third-, tenth- and fifteen-day descriptions should not be converted into an invented onset. The held status and withheld numeric duration remain appropriate.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
